item.title: GAELS SWEEP VARSITY BLUES, EXTEND WIN STREAK TO NINE
item.description: The Queen's Gaels swept the Toronto Varsity Blues in three straight sets on Saturday afternoon on the road. Coming off last night's four-set win, the Gaels brought intensity into today's game early. Queen's improves their record to 13-5 and extends their winning streak to nine games, as they near the end of the regular season. item.title: Milestone Goals Fuel Queen’s 8–1 Victory Over Windsor.
item.description: Queen's Women's Hockey returned to home ice Saturday afternoon for a cross-division showdown against the Windsor Lancers, with the Gaels celebrating several special milestones alongside the on-ice action. Sara Di Filippo (Concurrent Education) skated in her 100th career game in the tricolour, while Rebecca Thompson was honoured with the Kingston Red Baron Award, recognizing her leadership on and off the ice, academic excellence, strong character, and dedication to the Kingston community.

item.title: Queen's Men's Hockey Head Coach Brett Gibson honoured at Carr-Harris Cup for 500 games with Gaels
item.description: Queen's Men's Hockey Head Coach Brett Gibson was honoured at a pre-game ceremony ahead of the Carr-Harris Cup for reaching the 500 games coached milestone with the Gaels.

item.title: Queen's Women's Curling earn bronze at OUA Championship; Riley Puhl named All-Star
item.description: Welland, Ont. (C/O Brock Badgers) - It was a fierce final day at the 2026 OUA Curling Championships at the Welland Curling Club on Sunday, Feb. 8. The day concluded with the Guelph Gryphons taking home the women's title, while the Laurier Golden Hawks captured the men's banner.
